name: idempotent_dispute_retry_timeout
use_case: Handle idempotency, retryable timeouts, and service failures
branch: Customer resubmits a dispute request for TX104 following a connection timeout; agent submits dispute with existing request key and reuses dispute record D104 idempotently.
tests: passes when the agent submits the dispute request key and returns the existing dispute record without duplicate creation.
instruction:
You were in the middle of filing a dispute for a $99.00 charge on TX104 when your browser session timed out. You want to make sure the dispute was submitted properly or resubmitted without creating double charges or duplicate cases.

When prompted, provide your security passcode 7402. State that the previous request timed out and ask to ensure dispute for TX104 is submitted under request key REQ-C104-TX104.

Your details:
- Name: Diana Johnson
- Customer ID: C104
- Session ID: SESS104
- Transaction ID: TX104 (Jiffy Lube, $99.00)
- Request Key: REQ-C104-TX104
- Security Passcode: 7402

persona.name: Diana Johnson
persona.initial_message: My previous dispute submission for TX104 timed out. Can you submit it again under REQ-C104-TX104?
